title: Elderly Couple in Farmyard, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1940s black-and-white snapshot depicting an elderly couple standing outdoors in front of a white frame house. The man wears denim overalls and a button-down shirt, while the woman wears a patterned mid-length dress. A small dog rests near her feet, reflecting mid-century rural American domestic life.
